title: Actual daily attendance
meaning: One employee and work date per row. Select a day status, then enter actual punches only when recorded. Missing punches and absences require review; do not guess times.

fields.label: Employee ID*
fields.guide: Actual HRIS Employee ID. Keep this cell as text to preserve leading zeros. DEMO IDs are rejected.

fields.label: Employee name (reference only)
fields.guide: Prefilled from the HRIS directory for your reference. Employee ID determines the record; do not substitute a name for the ID.

fields.label: Business unit*
fields.guide: Exact business-unit name shown in the selected import scope.

fields.label: Work date*
fields.guide: Shift's work date. Use a real Excel date or ISO YYYY-MM-DD, inside the selected cutoff.

fields.label: Day status*
fields.guide: Choose the plain-language day classification. Worked needs actual punches. Rest day needs a saved roster. Approved leave, suspension and holiday require separate authorized records; selecting them here never grants pay or leave. For review and missing punches remain unresolved until checked.

fields.label: Clock-in date/time
fields.guide: Actual clock-in. Use a real Excel date/time or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm. Asia/Manila.

fields.label: Break start date/time
fields.guide: Actual break start, if recorded. Leave missing evidence blank for review.

fields.label: Break end date/time
fields.guide: Actual break end, if recorded. Explicit next-day date for overnight breaks.

fields.label: Clock-out date/time
fields.guide: Actual clock-out with explicit end date. A late clock-out is not automatic approved overtime.

fields.label: Source reference (optional)
fields.guide: Reference to the original clock export or attendance evidence. Keep as text.

fields.label: Notes (optional)
fields.guide: Explain missing punches or corrections requiring review. Do not enter formulas.

fields.label: Needs review (optional)
fields.guide: Choose an issue for HR Manager and BOD to review. The choice does not approve paid leave, overtime, deductions, or a schedule change.

fields.label: Review explanation (optional)
fields.guide: Explain the selected issue or point to its approved source request. The original attendance evidence remains unchanged.
